key_reasoning.reason: Rename of user_email to username across the LiteLLM identity chain touches agents, datasource processors, enterprise/litellm (llm_factory, dependencies, proxy_router, budget adapter, runtime sync), REST routers/handlers, budget and monitoring services, logger config and authentication. Many components but a mechanical rename with no new abstractions, so L rather than XL.

Behavior edits change the LiteLLM end_user identity (email to username) for datasource indexing and REST direct LLM/embedding calls, plus a personal-project guard edit in the identity resolver and authentication.py. This affects budget attribution and an auth-adjacent identity path, with metric label names deliberately kept stable. Rename is largely pattern-following, and fallback behavior is covered by tests.
43 files changed (31 source, 12 test), 547 insertions and 320 deletions. Per the diffstat mapping (16+ files) this is XXL, though almost all edits are small and mechanical.
